summary: Completed backend testing of the new performance analytics layer: metrics, costs, equity_curve, warnings, and slippage comparison. All 9 tests passed. The backtest API now returns comprehensive analytics including 18 metric fields, transaction costs with Zerodha-like modeling, equity curve with drawdown tracking, and appropriate warnings.
passed_tests: Metrics object with all 18 required fields: total_trades, win_rate, total_pnl_pct, sharpe_ratio, profit_factor, max_drawdown_pct, etc.
Costs object with brokerage (Rs 160 for 4 trades), stt (Rs 354.72), exchange_charges, config object
Equity curve starts at initial_capital=100000 with drawdown_pct=0
Slippage comparison: 0% slippage PnL=-42.11% vs 0.1% slippage PnL=-42.82% (difference 0.71%)
Zero trades edge case: no division errors, metrics all 0, sharpe=null, profit_factor=null, message present
Custom initial_capital=500000 applied correctly to equity curve
critical_code_review_comments: Metrics calculation correctly handles edge cases (zero trades, single trade)
Cost model includes all statutory charges: brokerage, STT, exchange charges, GST, stamp duty, SEBI charges
Equity curve correctly tracks drawdown percentage from peak
Slippage applied correctly: entry price increases (buy higher), exit price decreases (sell lower)
Code structure is clean with separate modules: engine.py, metrics.py, costs.py
